articles.summary: CHARLOTTE, N.C. , Nov. 20, 2025 /PRNewswire/ -- The Cato Corporation (NYSE: CATO) today reported a net loss of $5.2 million or ( $0.28 ) per diluted share for the third quarter ended November 1, 2025 , compared to a net loss of $15.1 million or ( $0.79 ) per diluted share for the third quarter
articles.title: CATO REPORTS 3Q RESULTS
